notes.subject: השקוץ משומם
notes.rationale: shikutz meshomem — tupela tok i pilai wantaim ol leta sh/s, i lus long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: התמיד
notes.rationale: 'ofa bilong oltaim': tamid em i 'oltaim/continual', KJV 'daily sacrifice' — em i ofa bilong evide, i no 'de' nating.

notes.subject: piksa nogut we i bagarapim olgeta
notes.rationale: Daniel i stap long hann bilong hait — buk i silim (Dan 12:4), olgeta tok long hia i stap hait yet.

translation: Na ol strongpela han bilong em bai i stanap, na ol bai bagarapim ⟨i⟩ ⟨את⟩ ples holi, strongpela banis; na ol bai rausim ⟨i⟩ ⟨את⟩ ofa bilong oltaim, na ol bai putim ⟨i⟩ ⟨את⟩ piksa nogut we i bagarapim olgeta.
